summary: Implemented U6 error accumulation: added a shared ErrorAccumulator (orchestrator/grouping/errors.py) used by _check_slice_overflow in pipeline.py (collects every over-cap slice before raising) and by plan_reader.py's _validate_shape, which now runs as two accumulated phases — shape errors first (stop and report if any), then reference errors (size_hints, duplicate ids, depends_on, cycle, slice cap) — preserving phase order. Single-error wording is byte-identical to before. Added new tests covering multi-error reporting in both test_grouper_pipeline.py and test_plan_reader.py. Full suite green aside from 5 pre-existing environment failures (sandbox permission denials writing to ~/.claude/projects and a /tmp cross-device-link issue in test_finish.py) unrelated to this change.

verification_results.notes: test_three_over_cap_slices_all_named_in_one_error asserts all three slice labels, sums, and overshoots appear in one GrouperError
existing tests/test_plan_reader.py and tests/test_grouper_pipeline.py pass unmodified; added test_single_over_cap_slice_wording_is_unchanged asserts exact original message text
